Subject: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + trust portal access

Hi Ana — thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Ask from Greenline: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), a bridge letter if the most recent report expiry falls outside your procurement window, and temporary trust portal access for evidence review. Also flagged: GDPR and HIPAA posture questions and the vendor security questionnaire you shared.

What I can do by EOD tomorrow: share our SOC 2 Type II cover summary and a standard bridge-letter template, and start the trust-portal invite flow (we can provision SSO if you prefer).

Requested from your side: a prioritized list of evidence items you'd like in the portal (e.g., change logs, access reviews, penetration test report) and whether procurement needs a download-able copy of the full report or the redacted summary.

Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire_greenline.xlsx (you emailed this prior to the call) — I’ve attached it here so we can track answers in one place.

Mutual action plan (proposed):
- 8/6: Redwood sends SOC 2 summary + bridge-letter template + initial portal invite
- 8/9: Greenline confirms evidence list & provides questionnaire sections to prioritize
- 8/13: Redwood uploads requested evidence to portal; Greenline completes review

If that timeline works I’ll start the portal provisioning and share an internal contact for technical evidence uploads.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0132
https://redwoodinference.com

From: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@greenlinehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + trust portal access

Thanks Tessa — great summary. A few clarifications and a couple of asks from my side: 

1) For the SOC 2: we need the most recent Type II report (PSP) or a signed bridge letter if the Type II is older than 12 months. A redacted PDF is fine for procurement, but technical reviewers will want the full evidence set in the portal.
2) Portal access: we prefer SSO via Okta; our IdP team can exchange metadata. If SSO takes longer, a time-limited service account will work.
3) GDPR/HIPAA: Greenline is HIPAA-covered; we’ll need confirmation of BAAs for any PHI processing. A short DPA/DPA addendum template would help.

For the vendor questionnaire I attached two priority tabs: "A — Immediate" and "B — Optional". We’ll need answers to A by 8/10. I’ve also added a column for date-by-which we need artifacts.

Can you send the SOC 2 summary and bridge-letter template today so I can loop in legal and IdP? 

Best,
Ana
Ana Gomez
CISO, Greenline Health

Thanks — Tessa

Hi Ana — Marissa here from Compliance. Quick update: 

- I provisioned the Greenline workspace at https://trust.redwoodinference.com/portal/greenlinehealth and sent invites to ana.gomez@greenlinehealth.com and idp-admin@greenlinehealth.com with reviewer roles. You should see the invite with a 7-day accept window.
- I uploaded the initial evidence bundle: network_diagram.pdf, change_control_samples.zip (attachment stub), and the full SOC 2 package into a restricted folder. Procurement should be able to download a redacted SOC 2 PDF from the portal landing page.
- Technical checklist (paste): network diagrams, architecture whiteboard, identity/access reviews, code change logs, patch management proof, pen test summary, incident response playbook, selected cloud audit logs (last 90 days), vendor BAA copy.

If you need any item moved to a wider access folder for engineering reviewers, reply here and we’ll change permissions. We can also start a DocuSign envelope for the bridge letter if procurement confirms signer details.

cc: Rishi is available for any technical control clarifications; he’ll follow-up on questionnaire A items marked "detailed evidence".

Best — Marissa
